title: scSimEvalStudio: Interactive Shiny App for Single-Cell Simulation Benchmarking
text: scSimEvalStudio (version 0.99.4) is the beginner-friendly, point-and-click Shiny web application companion to scSimEval. Compare single-cell RNA-seq, ATAC-seq, and multiomics simulation methods right in your browser without writing plotting or analysis code. Visit https://kabilanbio.github.io/scSimEval/ for statistical methods and the full 56-metric catalog.

title: scSimEvalStudio: Interactive Shiny App for Single-Cell Simulation Benchmarking
text: Install scSimEvalStudio from Bioconductor or GitHub, launch the Shiny app with launch_scSimEval_app(), and explore 1-click built-in example datasets or upload your own SingleCellExperiment or Seurat .rds files.

what: Inside the Shiny Studio (At a Glance)
title: scSimEvalStudio: Interactive Shiny App for Single-Cell Simulation Benchmarking
text: Home, Data Hub, Comparative Bubble Matrix, Visualizations (8 interactive chart tabs), Benchmark Results & Export (Excel, CSV, RDS, 600 DPI figures), Help & Getting Started, Logs, and Contact.

title: Beginner's Guide to scSimEvalStudio
text: Point-and-click Shiny web app for single-cell and multiomics simulation benchmarking. Try 1-click example datasets, upload SingleCellExperiment or Seurat .rds files, compare simulators on a simple 0 to 1 scale, and download 600 DPI figures and Excel workbooks.

what: 3. Step 2 — Load Data in the Data Hub Tab
title: Beginner's Guide to scSimEvalStudio
text: 4 easy options in Data Hub: 1-click example datasets (Rice Bud or Soybean Root), upload single-cell scRNA-seq or scATAC-seq .rds files, upload paired or unpaired multiomics .rds files, or reload saved .rds or .csv results. Includes 1-click Download R Script for large datasets.

what: 4. Step 3 — Compare Simulators at a Glance
title: Beginner's Guide to scSimEvalStudio
text: Read the Comparative Bubble Matrix and Fidelity Leaderboard on a simple 0.0 to 1.0 scale where bigger circles mean better scores and a bold black outline marks the top simulator per metric.

title: Beginner's Guide to scSimEvalStudio
text: 8 interactive chart tabs: Evaluation Summary, Distribution QC, Metric Heatmap, Metric Plots, PCA Ordination, MDS Metric Space, Cell Embeddings (UMAP, t-SNE & PCA), and Scalability Benchmark, with 25%-400% zoom, pan, Full View lightbox, 600 DPI JPEG/PDF export, and 1-click R script export.

what: 6. Step 5 — Export Results, Monitor Progress & Get Help
title: Beginner's Guide to scSimEvalStudio
text: Download Excel (.xlsx), CSV, or full .rds session backups in Benchmark Results & Export; monitor live progress in Logs; access in-app tips and contact details in Help & Contact.

what: Launch Interactive scSimEval Benchmarking Studio — launch_scSimEval_app
title: Launch Interactive scSimEval Benchmarking Studio — launch_scSimEval_app
text: Launches the companion Shiny web application bundled in scSimEvalStudio with a default 10 GiB upload limit.

what: scSimEvalStudio: Interactive Shiny Studio for scSimEval Single-Cell Multiomics Benchmarking — scSimEvalStudio-package
